# who-iris-docs

This instance's docs, with a viewer built by cat-harness. Declared in this instance's own file rather than in `cat-harness.json`, because `compose-docs.docsLayers` treats every docs-kind entry there as a composition layer and would overlay this instance's `index.md` onto the site's own. The directory is also mounted verbatim at `/docs/who-iris/`: the mount is a copy of the directory, the viewer an index of it, and the rail links to the viewer (`visualiserHref`).

Part of [WHO IRIS](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `who-iris-docs`, holding `docs`.
